### [CustomDateRange](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.4.0/interfaces/CustomDateRange)
A predefined date range with label for IgcDateRangePickerComponent.customRanges


### [DatePartDeltas](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.4.0/interfaces/DatePartDeltas)
The amounts by which each date or time part is incremented or decremented on
a step action in date-time input; every part defaults to 1.

- **date?**: `number` — The number of days the date part is spun by.
- **hours?**: `number` — The number of hours the hours part is spun by.
- **minutes?**: `number` — The number of minutes the minutes part is spun by.
- **month?**: `number` — The number of months the month part is spun by.
- **seconds?**: `number` — The number of seconds the seconds part is spun by.
- **year?**: `number` — The number of years the year part is spun by.

### [DateRangeDescriptor](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.4.0/interfaces/DateRangeDescriptor)
Describes a set of dates by combining a range type with the dates it applies to.

- **dateRange?**: `Date[]` — The date or dates the descriptor applies to, interpreted according to DateRangeDescriptor.type.
DateRangeType.After and DateRangeType.Before use the first date,
DateRangeType.Between uses the first and the last, and
DateRangeType.Specific matches every date listed. Not used by
DateRangeType.Weekdays and DateRangeType.Weekends.
- **type**: `DateRangeType` — The kind of range being described, which determines how DateRangeDescriptor.dateRange is matched.

### [FilteringOptions](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.4.0/interfaces/FilteringOptions)
Filtering options for the combo component.

- **caseSensitive?**: `boolean` — Determines whether the filtering operation should be case sensitive.
- **filterKey**: `any | undefined` — The key in the data source used when filtering the list of options.
- **matchDiacritics?**: `boolean` — When true, the filter distinguishes between accented letters and their base letters.

### [IconMeta](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.4.0/interfaces/IconMeta)
Identifies a registered icon by its name and the collection it belongs to.

- **collection**: `string` — The name of the collection the icon is registered in.
- **external?**: `boolean` — Internal use only.
- **name**: `string` — The name identifier of the icon in the collection.

### [IgcCalendarResourceStrings](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.4.0/interfaces/IgcCalendarResourceStrings)
**Deprecated:** since 7.2.0. Use the newly provided ICalendarResourceStrings interface, or set global resource strings with the registerI18n method.


### [IgcChatComponentEventMap](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.4.0/interfaces/IgcChatComponentEventMap)
Defines the custom events dispatched by the chat component.

- **igcAttachmentAdded**: `CustomEvent<IgcChatMessageAttachment[]>` — Dispatched when attachment(s) are added either through drag & drop or through
the default file input.
- **igcAttachmentClick**: `CustomEvent<IgcChatMessageAttachment>` — Dispatched when a chat message attachment is clicked.
- **igcAttachmentDrag**: `CustomEvent<void>` — Dispatched during an attachment drag operation.
- **igcAttachmentDrop**: `CustomEvent<void>` — Dispatched when an attachment is dropped (e.g., in a drag-and-drop operation).
- **igcAttachmentRemoved**: `CustomEvent<IgcChatMessageAttachment>` — Dispatched when an attachment is removed by the user.
- **igcInputBlur**: `CustomEvent<void>` — Dispatched when the chat input field loses focus.
- **igcInputChange**: `CustomEvent<string>` — Dispatched when the content of the chat input changes.
- **igcInputFocus**: `CustomEvent<void>` — Dispatched when the chat input field gains focus.
- **igcMessageCreated**: `CustomEvent<IgcChatMessage>` — Dispatched when a new chat message is created (sent).
- **igcMessageReact**: `CustomEvent<IgcChatMessageReaction>` — Dispatched when a message is reacted to.
- **igcTypingChange**: `CustomEvent<boolean>` — Dispatched when the typing status changes (e.g., user starts or stops typing).

### [IgcChatDraftMessage](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.4.0/interfaces/IgcChatDraftMessage)
Represents a draft message that is being composed by the user, including the text and any attachments.

- **attachments?**: `IgcChatMessageAttachment[]` — An array of attachments associated with the draft message.
- **text**: `string` — The textual content of the draft message.

### [IgcChatMessage](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.4.0/interfaces/IgcChatMessage)
Represents a single chat message in the conversation.

- **attachments?**: `IgcChatMessageAttachment[]` — Optional list of attachments associated with the message,
such as images, files, or links.
- **id**: `string` — A unique identifier for the message.
- **reactions?**: `string[]` — Optional list of reactions associated with the message.
- **sender**: `string` — The identifier or name of the sender of the message.
- **text**: `string` — The textual content of the message.
- **timestamp?**: `string` — The timestamp indicating when the message was sent.

### [IgcChatMessageAttachment](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.4.0/interfaces/IgcChatMessageAttachment)
Represents an attachment associated with a chat message.

- **file?**: `File` — The actual File object, if the attachment was provided locally (e.g. via upload).
- **id**: `string` — A unique identifier for the attachment.
- **name**: `string` — The display name of the attachment (e.g. file name).
- **thumbnail?**: `string` — Optional URL to a thumbnail preview of the attachment (e.g. for images or videos).
- **type?**: `string` — The MIME type or a custom type identifier for the attachment (e.g. "image/png", "pdf", "audio").
- **url?**: `string` — The URL from which the attachment can be downloaded or viewed.
Typically used for attachments stored on a server or CDN.

### [IgcChatMessageReaction](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.4.0/interfaces/IgcChatMessageReaction)
Represents a user's reaction to a specific chat message.

- **message**: `IgcChatMessage` — The chat message that the reaction is associated with.
- **reaction**: `string` — The string representation of the reaction, such as an emoji or a string;

### [IgcChatOptions](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.4.0/interfaces/IgcChatOptions)
Configuration options for customizing the behavior and appearance of the chat component.

- **acceptedFiles?**: `string` — The accepted files that could be attached.
Defines the file types as a list of comma-separated values (e.g. "image/*,.pdf") that the file input should accept.
- **adoptRootStyles?**: `boolean` — A boolean flag that, when true, enables a **quick and dirty workaround** for styling
components rendered within the Shadow DOM, from custom message renderers, by allowing them
to inherit styles from the document's root. This can be useful for developers who prefer not to handle
Shadow DOM encapsulation, but it is **not the recommended approach**.

It is highly advised to use standard Web Component styling methods first, in this order:

1.  **CSS Variables and Parts API**: Use the exposed ::part API with custom CSS variables to style
your content in your custom renderers.

2.  **link elements**: For larger style sheets, link them directly within the Shadow DOM to maintain
encapsulation.

3.  **Inline <style> tags**: Use these for small, self-contained styles within a template.

This property should be used as a **last resort** as it can lead to **style leakage**, where
global styles unexpectedly bleed into the component, breaking encapsulation and causing
unpredictable visual issues.
- **currentUserId?**: `string` — The ID of the current user. Used to differentiate between incoming and outgoing messages.
- **disableAutoScroll?**: `boolean` — If true, prevents the chat from automatically scrolling to the latest message.
- **disableInputAttachments?**: `boolean` — If true, disables the ability to upload and send attachments.
Defaults to false.
- **headerText?**: `string` — Optional header text to display at the top of the chat component.
- **inputPlaceholder?**: `string` — Optional placeholder text for the chat input area.
Provides a hint to the user about what they can type (e.g. "Type a message...").
- **isTyping?**: `boolean` — Indicates whether the other user is currently typing a message.
- **renderers?**: `ChatRenderers` — An object containing a collection of custom renderers for different parts of the chat UI.
- **stopTypingDelay?**: `number` — Time in milliseconds to wait before dispatching a stop typing event.
Default is 3000.
- **suggestions?**: `string[]` — Suggested text snippets or quick replies that can be shown as user-selectable options.
- **suggestionsPosition?**: `ChatSuggestionsPosition` — Controls the position of the chat suggestions within the component layout.

- "below-input": Renders suggestions below the chat input area.
- "below-messages": Renders suggestions below the chat messages area.

Default is "below-messages".

### [IgcChatResourceStrings](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.4.0/interfaces/IgcChatResourceStrings)
**Deprecated:** since 7.2.0. Use the newly provided IChatResourceStrings interface, or set global resource strings with the registerI18n method.


### [IgcDateRangePickerResourceStrings](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.4.0/interfaces/IgcDateRangePickerResourceStrings)
**Deprecated:** since 7.2.0. Use the newly provided ICalendarResourceStrings and IDateRangePickerResourceStrings interfaces, or set global resource strings with the registerI18n method.


### [QrCodeExportOptions](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.4.0/interfaces/QrCodeExportOptions)
Options for exporting the QR code to a file.

- **download?**: `boolean` — Whether to open the browser download dialog for the exported file.
- **fileName?**: `string` — The name of the exported file. The extension of the format is appended when the name does not end with it.
- **format?**: `QrCodeExportFormat` — The output format.
- **scale?**: `number` — Multiplier applied to the size of the component. A 256px QR code with a scale of 2 exports as a 512x512 image.
For svg, the multiplier applies to the width and height attributes while the viewBox is unchanged.

### [RegisterIconOptions](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.4.0/interfaces/RegisterIconOptions)
Options for registering an SVG icon.

- **collection?**: `string` — The collection to register the icon in.
- **stripMeta?**: `boolean` — Whether to strip SVG meta elements (<title> and <desc>) from the icon
before storing it.

### [VirtualScrollDataRequest](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.4.0/interfaces/VirtualScrollDataRequest)
A request for more data, emitted when the rendered window comes near the
end of the loaded items. Consumers listen for it and append the requested
items.

- **count**: `number` — Number of items being requested.
- **startIndex**: `number` — The first index that does not yet have data.
Append at least count more items starting here.

### [VirtualScrollItemContext](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.4.0/interfaces/VirtualScrollItemContext)
Context passed to the item template: the item data, its index, and utility
properties for rendering.

- **count**: `number` — The total number of items
- **index**: `number` — The index of the current item
- **value**: `T` — The current item in the virtual scroll
- **isFirst**: `any`
- **isLast**: `any`

### [VirtualScrollState](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.4.0/interfaces/VirtualScrollState)
Snapshot of the currently rendered virtual window

- **endIndex**: `number` — The index of the last item currently rendered in the viewport (inclusive).
- **startIndex**: `number` — The index of the first item currently rendered in the viewport.
- **totalSize**: `number` — The total size of the virtual scroll content in pixels.
- **viewportSize**: `number` — The size of the viewport in pixels.

## Type Aliases

### [ChatSuggestionsPosition](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.4.0/types/ChatSuggestionsPosition)
`"below-input" | "below-messages"`
A string literal type defining the two possible positions for chat suggestions.

### [ChatTemplateRenderer](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.4.0/types/ChatTemplateRenderer)
`any`
A generic type for a function that serves as a custom renderer.
It takes a context object of type T and returns a template result.

### [PopoverPlacement](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.4.0/types/PopoverPlacement)
`"top" | "top-start" | "top-end" | "bottom" | "bottom-start" | "bottom-end" | "right" | "right-start" | "right-end" | "left" | "left-start" | "left-end"`
Describes the preferred placement of a toggle component.

### [QrCodeExportFormat](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.4.0/types/QrCodeExportFormat)
`"svg" | "png" | "jpeg" | "webp"`
Output format of an exported QR code.

### [QrCornerSquareStyle](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.4.0/types/QrCornerSquareStyle)
`"square" | "circle" | "rounded"`
Shape of the outer square of each finder-pattern corner.

### [QrDotStyle](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.4.0/types/QrDotStyle)
`"square" | "circle" | "rounded"`
Shape of individual data modules in the QR code body.

### [QrErrorCorrectionLevel](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents/7.4.0/types/QrErrorCorrectionLevel)
`"L" | "M" | "Q" | "H"`
QR error correction level. Higher levels recover more data but reduce capacity.
- L ~7%, M ~15%, Q ~25%, H ~30%.

  import { configureTheme } from 'igniteui-webcomponents';

 configureTheme('material', 'light');
